Market today: "AI fatigue" is hitting chip stocks hard, marking their worst stretch in 16 months. This directly impacts your heavily concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: MUU (-22.32%), SOXL (-43.24%), and SPAL (-27.87%) are all leveraged ETFs in "SELL" status and deep drawdowns. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on further weakness in the chip sector and how the market reacts to AI companies' profitability disclosures.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged positions amidst sector weakness.
plays: Review stops on MUU, SOXL, and SPAL. Consider trimming these leveraged ETFs to reduce exposure to ongoing sector weakness and decay.
